title: Gender and Preferences for Performance Feedback
eligible_reason: Not a DiD design. Online/lab experiments (cognitive test, mock interview, forecast survey) analysed with cross-sectional OLS of feedback demand and beliefs on female, task difficulty or blind-evaluation treatments, controls and interactions; areg with person FE only for within-forecaster comparisons across prices. No panel with adoption timing.
design_notes: Stata regress/areg with robust SE; 2SLS for beliefs; 94 regression commands in the inventory, all cross-sectional or within-person across elicitation items.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text or PDF). Experimental paper; no DiD.
